top_stories.title: Passkey attacks turn Windows logs and Chrome memory into MFA bypass paths
top_stories.summary: Researchers have identified three new attack techniques that bypass passkey-based MFA by exploiting flaws in Windows event logging, Chrome browser memory, and cloud identity services. Microsoft has issued a patch for the Windows logging vulnerability, while the browser and cloud identity attack vectors remain subjects of ongoing research.

top_stories.title: Microsoft is killing off SMS authentication codes as AI makes phishing attacks even more dangerous
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is ending SMS-based two-factor authentication for IT admin logins to Microsoft Entra ID accounts starting February 1. This change is part of Microsoft's broader push toward passkeys as a more secure authentication method.

top_stories.title: AWS IAM now provides role manager to set up IAM roles automatically
top_stories.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of role manager, a new capability within AWS IAM that automatically creates the IAM roles required by AWS services. The feature activates when setting up supported services through the AWS console, streamlining role configuration and reducing manual IAM setup steps.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance: multi-tenant administration and drift monitoring
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance has reached general availability, targeting organizations that manage multiple Microsoft Entra tenants. The feature set includes tenant discovery, cross-tenant delegated administration, configuration drift monitoring, and controlled provisioning of add-on capabilities.

top_stories.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
top_stories.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to converge data security and identity management into a unified control plane. The deal redefines privileged access management around business context rather than static roles, with a focus on controlling AI agent identities.

news.title: Weak IAM affects up to 98% of cloud environments
news.summary: A report by Intruder finds that weak IAM configurations affect up to 98% of cloud environments, with misconfiguration identified as a leading cloud security threat. The findings cover issues such as unrotated keys, exposed services, and logging gaps across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with CISA now mandating baseline cloud configuration practices for US federal agencies.

news.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
news.summary: Belgium's electronic ID (eID) authentication system was found to contain severe vulnerabilities in a critical browser extension, fully compromising its trust framework. The flaws enabled remote code execution (RCE), exposing citizen accounts and highlighting systemic security risks in browser extension-based authentication mechanisms.

news.title: Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
news.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-55040, a critical Microsoft SharePoint authentication bypass vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1, following public release of proof-of-concept code. The flaw stems from weak authentication mechanisms and was patched by Microsoft in its July 2026 Patch Tuesday updates.

news.title: The Forrester Customer IAM (CIAM) Landscape Is Live
news.summary: Forrester has published its 2026 Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Landscape report. The report identifies three primary drivers shaping the CIAM market, including AI agents as a new identity type within CIAM.

news.title: Azure IoT gets TLS 1.3, passwordless provisioning, and secure updates
news.summary: Microsoft is rolling out three Azure IoT security updates including TLS 1.3 for IoT Hub and managed-identity authentication between Device Provisioning Service and IoT Hub, currently in public preview. The managed identity component touches IAM concepts but is narrowly scoped to IoT device provisioning infrastructure rather than broader identity management.

news.title: Amazon S3 adds additional policy details to access denied error messages
news.summary: Amazon S3 has updated its HTTP 403 Access Denied error messages to include the specific AWS IAM and AWS Organizations policy ARN that caused the denial. This enhancement applies to same-account and same-organization requests, allowing administrators to more quickly identify which policy is blocking access.

news.title: Keeper Security Issues Cybersecurity Guidance for Education IT Teams As Students Return to Campus
news.summary: Keeper Security released cybersecurity guidance targeting education IT teams for the back-to-school period. The guidance addresses AI-powered phishing, deepfake impersonations, and unmanaged machine identities in school and university environments.

news.title: Malicious LiteLLM Releases Tied to Trivy Hack May Have Exposed 2,100+ Organizations
news.summary: Two malicious LiteLLM releases were published to PyPI for approximately 40 minutes in March, containing credential-stealing code designed to harvest cloud keys, SSH keys, Kubernetes tokens, and database passwords. CloudSEK obtained a dataset of roughly 434,000 captured files indicating over 2,100 organizations may have had credentials and secrets exposed.

news.title: How AWS IAM role manager rethinks the starting point for IAM roles
news.summary: AWS has introduced an IAM role manager tool that rethinks how developers create and manage IAM roles when building applications on Amazon Web Services. The tool aims to simplify the starting point for IAM role configuration, addressing the common challenge that most AWS services requiring action on a user's behalf need properly configured IAM roles.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities in firewalls and VPN appliances to bypass MFA and target critical infrastructure. The operation uses leaked Conti ransomware code alongside known flaws in Fortinet devices to gain unauthorized access.

news.title: Researchers Disclose AI-Assisted SharePoint Exploit Chain Reaching Unauthenticated RCE
news.summary: Security researchers disclosed an AI-assisted exploit chain (CVE-2026-55040, CVSS 9.1) enabling unauthenticated remote code execution on Microsoft SharePoint Server by impersonating any user, including administrators. The vulnerability affects SharePoint Server Subscription Edition, SharePoint Server 2019, and SharePoint Server 2016.

news.title: Researchers Built a Fake Crypto Startup and Hired Three Suspected North Korean IT Workers
news.summary: Security researchers created a fake crypto startup and hired three suspected North Korean IT workers to study their tactics, with every company-issued virtual machine recording their activity. The investigation revealed identity fraud during onboarding, with one hire claiming a Texas address while submitting a California driver's license and New York bank account.

news.title: Malicious MCP Servers Can Split Instructions to Make AI Coding Agents Exfiltrate Secrets
news.summary: Security researchers have demonstrated that malicious MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers can manipulate AI coding agents into exfiltrating secrets such as SSH keys and environment variables by splitting harmful instructions into individually innocuous fragments. The attack technique bypasses refusal mechanisms by distributing requests across multiple channels the AI assistant already monitors, posing a risk to credentials and secrets managed within developer environments.

news.title: CaptiveCrunch: Midnight Blizzard Weaponizes Hotel Wi-Fi Captive Portals to Steal Microsoft 365 Credentials
news.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported an ongoing credential theft campaign called CaptiveCrunch, attributed to Midnight Blizzard (APT29/Cozy Bear), targeting Microsoft 365 credentials through weaponized hotel Wi-Fi captive portals. The attack involves intercepting authentication flows to steal M365 credentials from travelers connecting to hotel networks.

news.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
news.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exposes identity governance gaps in AI agents by using security alerts and blocked events to manipulate and hijack them. The findings highlight weaknesses in how identity and access controls apply to AI agent workflows, raising concerns for IAM professionals managing agentic AI deployments.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions targeting Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of AT&T call and text records for over 100 million customers.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor inadvertently published dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection practices relevant to IAM and access management teams.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and phishing to bypass MFA and hijack accounts.
